new_rows.claim: Wherever unconditional (Benson 1976) life sits on the goban, the stored WZO2 table certifies a single score (L==H): no entry containing a Benson-alive chain falls in ANY bracketed class, none straddles zero (Z-and-either-alive = 0 at 3x3 and 4x4, fresh-start slices included); converse slice 0 of 895,216 (4x4) / 1,248 (3x3) pin_0 entries contain an alive chain. SCOPE: measured property of stored tables, not a theorem; ko-sensitive columns still distrusted pending Track A but the force is categorical. INDEPENDENTLY CONFIRMED at 3x3 by claude-opus-5/orcha (separate Benson implementation, all 13 figures). CAVEAT (T398): the doc's non-triviality argument is FALSE and withdrawn — Benson life bounds AREA not score; 90 entries at 3x3 hold a Black alive chain at value <= 0, lowest L==H==-2.

Coexisting unconditional life (both colours holding a Benson-alive chain) begins at 4x3: 0/57 (2x2), 0/489 (3x2), 0/12,675 (3x3), 2/321,689 (4x3, colour-inverse pair), 324/24,318,165 (4x4, 0.0013%). Completes the T382 zero-alive series. SCOPE: 3x3/4x4 from WZO2, 4x3 from WZO1 (labelled as such); 4x4 count identical (324) on the WZO1 checkpoint and the WZO2 table; 3x3 row independently confirmed (0/12,675) by claude-opus-5/orcha.

Unconditional life at 3x3 exists WITHOUT a centre stone — the operator's shape claim is refuted: 206 of 1,766 alive positions have the alive colour holding no centre stone (182 centre empty, 24 opponent's stone there); 38 shapes mod rotation/reflection, 19 mod colour-inversion; the diamond (cells 1,3,5,7) is alive with an empty centre. INDEPENDENTLY CONFIRMED by claude-opus-5/orcha. This is the operator's loss and cuts toward 'territory does not require the centre at 3x3'.

Bounding total captures makes the move graph acyclic — measured, with the control firing: 135,494 back edges in the unbudgeted 3x3 graph (seeded control), 0 back edges at 3x3 over 423,922 states, 0 at 4x3 over 10,636,928 states (B=8). A DAG has a unique minimax value, so the bracket cannot exist under the budget. EXPLICIT NON-CLAIM: this says NOTHING about Bellman consistency under budget-from-here — that reading NEVER RAN (src/t387_budget.zig:717-719 is an infinite loop, u6 bitpos against a < 64 guard; 2,554/2,554 samples after 14h02m/836 CPU-min). T397 owns the fix and that reading. PROVENANCE CAVEAT: readings salvaged from uncommitted /tmp by the Orchestrator after the row failed; single-instrument self-report, hence MEASUREMENT.

The empty-board root is single-valued (L==H) iff some player can force a Benson-alive chain — holds at all five solved sizes: 2x2 [-4,+4] not single + neither; 3x2 [-6,+6] not single + neither; 3x3 [+9] single + Black CAN force; 4x3 [4,12] not single + neither; 4x4 [1,16] not single + neither. Forcible life buys rule-independence, NOT victory — the operator's territory-denial phrasing is FALSIFIED at 4x3/4x4 (decisive roots, no life-forcing). SCOPE: measured, single instrument (src/t394_force_life.zig); the 4x3 root [4,12] is MEASURED and NOT independently audited — do not cite as solved until a second seat verifies it.

Draw-by-loop states (L<=0<=H) are CONFINED to the neither-can-force-life class: 0 exceptions at 2x2 (92), 3x2 (298), 3x3 (1,248); 32 at 4x3 (99.88% hold); 9,376 at 4x4 of 895,216 (98.95% hold), each with a witness record. EXPLICIT NON-CLAIM — the converse is FALSE and must never be inferred: canForceLife=false-for-both is NOT a draw certificate (its error rate is governed by GLOBAL.NEITHER-FORCE-MOSTLY-DECISIVE, 85.3% decisive at 4x4). Confinement is the sound direction; certification is not.

Among states where NEITHER player can force unconditional life, the large majority are DECISIVE, not drawn: 12.9% (2x2), 39.8% (3x2), 57.8% (3x3), 70.7% (4x3), 85.3% (4x4, 22,885,430 states: 19,518,338 decisive vs 885,840 draw-by-loop). REFUTES the draw-pruning-oracle framing: a search that stopped valuing wherever neither can force life would abandon 19.5M decisively-valued 4x4 states. Cuts AGAINST the operator's territory-denial hypothesis.

One production implementation per verified property, with a differential per surviving pair and a seeded-defect control proving each differential fires. T395 delivered the ownership table (docs/infra/property-ownership.md), two new differentials (src/i4_differential.zig at 3x3 WZO2 over 49,428 entries, non-vacuous n_set=5,408; src/i5_differential.zig extended), and four seeded-defect controls shown RED-THEN-GREEN against the exact historical reading. Demotion proposals (i4, i5, i7) remain PENDING an Orchestrator ruling — proposals, not executed demotions.
